issue_context.title: srp_engry doesn't create any devices or entities
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When I add the srp_entity integration, starting a few releases ago (maybe 2024.3.0 or so), it no longer creates any devices or entities.  After upgrading, the entities just went unavailable.  I then removed the integration and re-added it back.  It detected that my account had a name "Home" in it, but no devices or entities under that are created.

![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/1817474/db3e7111-e1a2-4515-b1ec-4c8489c6e13c)

Log after reloading the integration with debug enabled.  It appears to get records correctly, but just does not put it anywhere?  I am on a time of use plan (and checked that box).

`2023-06-29 11:33:21.191 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.srp_energy] Configuring client using account_id *********
2023-06-29 11:33:21.192 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.srp_energy] async_update_data enter
2023-06-29 11:33:21.832 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.srp_energy] async_update_data: Received 24 record(s) from 2023-06-28 11:33:21.193017-07:00 to 2023-06-29 11:33:21.193017-07:00
2023-06-29 11:33:21.832 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.srp_energy] async_update_data: previous_daily_usage 109.10000000000001
2023-06-29 11:33:21.832 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.srp_energy] Finished fetching sensor data in 0.640 seconds (success: True)
`

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.6.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2023.2.0

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

srp_energy

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/srp_energy

### Diagnostics information

[home-assistant_srp_energy_2023-06-29T18-40-40.289Z.log](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/11909436/home-assistant_srp_energy_2023-06-29T18-40-40.289Z.log)
